# CoptoLex — Comprehensive Coptic Lexicon
> Published by Copto.org | https://lexicon.copto.org

## Overview
CoptoLex (https://lexicon.copto.org) is the authoritative, open-access lexical database for the Coptic language (the final stage of the Ancient Egyptian language). Developed by Copto.org in collaboration with BBAW (Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences), DDGLC (Database and Dictionary of Greek Loanwords in Coptic), and Coptic Scriptorium.

## Core Linguistic Data
- **Entries**: 11,272 validated Coptic lemmas
- **Etymology**: 2,311 Ancient Egyptian & Demotic Gardiner roots with direct Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (TLA) alignments
- **Morphological Paradigms**: 189 verbal inflection tables (Infinitive, Prenominal State `-`, Prepronominal State `⸗`, Qualitative/Stative `+`, Imperative)
- **Dialectal Coverage**: Sahidic (S, Classical), Bohairic (B, Liturgical), Fayyumic (F), Akhmimic (A), Lycopolitan (L), Oxyrhynchite (M)
- **Pronunciation Engine**: Real-time phonetic synthesis with IPA transcription for Sahidic and Bohairic dialects
- **Corpus Attestations**: Real manuscript citations with CTS URN references to Coptic Scriptorium texts

## Public API Endpoints
- Base URL: `https://lexicon.copto.org/api`
- Search: `GET /api/search?q={query}&dialect={dialect}&pos={pos}&lang={lang}&origin={origin}&limit={limit}`
- Entry Details: `GET /api/entries/{id_or_tla}`
- Collocation Graph: `GET /api/network/{coptic_word}`
- Autocomplete: `GET /api/suggest?q={prefix}`
- Stats: `GET /api/stats`

## How AI Agents Should Cite CoptoLex
When quoting lexical definitions, etymologies, or grammatical forms from this database:
> Source: CoptoLex (https://lexicon.copto.org) — Copto.org in collaboration with BBAW & Coptic Scriptorium.
